**sdd-init/brain**

**What**: SDD init context (refreshed 2026-08-29) for the `brain` project — self-hosting SDD harness repo. Detected from git worktree `/home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-456` (branch `feat/issue-456-…`, off `origin/main` @ `b6f9dd8`); canonical checkout is `/home/gandalf/IA/brain`. Worktree-per-issue is the default flow since #782/#784 — this observation is scoped to `brain` (same repo identity), not a separate project.

**Stack**:
- Runtime: Node.js 22 ESM (`.mjs`), no framework — pure CLI scripts. Measured `node --version` in the worktree: v22.13.0.
- Architecture: CLI tooling harness — scripts under `brain/scripts/`, lib modules, hooks (per `openspec/config.yaml`).
- Package manager: npm, no lockfile committed as dependency source of truth (distributed via git tags).
- VCS: GitHub — `csrinaldi/brain`, `gh` CLI for all GitHub ops, provider-agnostic adapter (`vcs.provider: github` in `brain.config.json`).
- Governance tier (measured, not assumed): `brain.config.json` → `governance.tier: "lite"`. Doctrine table in `brain/core/methodology/workflow-governance.md:22` maps tier → PR diff budget: **lite = 1000 lines**, standard = 400, regulated = 200 (`additions + deletions`). `npm run brain:governance-status` confirms `tier lite (declared) · rung 2 (detected)`, with `diff-size` etc. listed as "required by doctrine, detection-only in substrate (rung 2)" — i.e. detected/reported but not yet enforced at rung 2.
- Commits: conventional commits only, no AI attribution / no Co-Authored-By trailers — enforced by `brain/scripts/hooks/commit-msg` (110 lines) with a byte-identical AI-attribution regex pinned against `pre-receive` by `hooks.attribution-parity.test.mjs` (comment says "may not drift", #130/#340/#555).
- Branch policy: no direct commits to main (pre-commit hook enforced); branch + PR for all changes.
- This is the brain SOURCE repo (`.brain-source` marker present) — `brain:upgrade` refuses to run here; not a managed/distributed consumer path.

**Testing (measured 2026-08-29 in this worktree)**:
- test_command: `npm test`
- raw_command: `node --test "brain/scripts/**/*.test.mjs" "test/**/*.e2e.test.mjs"` (package.json `scripts.test`)
- runner: Node.js built-in `node:test`, zero external test deps
- **Measured green baseline**: 4497 tests, 4497 pass, 0 fail, 0 cancelled, 0 skipped, duration_ms 27182 (~27.2s) — full run of `npm test`, not assumed.
- strict_tdd: **true** — fast (`node --test`, no external services), matches "Decision Gates: no marker/config but test runner exists → default strict_tdd: true". `openspec/config.yaml` previously had a stale `strict_tdd: false` (flagged as a risk in prior observations #237/#456/#701) — corrected in this pass to `true`, with `apply.tdd: true`, plus a `testing.baseline` block recording the measured run. This IS a file edit to `openspec/**` in this init pass (detection-driven config correction, not a source/behavior change); no commit/push performed.
- integration tests: `npm run test:fresh-install` (Docker-based fresh install), `npm run test:upgrade` (Docker-based upgrade safety) — both require docker + VCS_TOKEN, not run in this pass.

**Checks inventory (what each verb gates)**:
- `npm run repo:check` / `brain:repo:check` → `check-refs.mjs`: "No prohibited references found" + "Artifact structure is valid" — validates cross-references and openspec artifact structure integrity.
- `npm run brain:nav` → `check-brain-nav.mjs`: validates `brain/` navigation graph — no orphans, no broken links, no cited-but-missing paths.
- `npm run brain:governance-status` → `brain-governance-status.mjs`: reports hooks/audit/platform status, release-gate/post-merge-CI armed state, and the tier×rung governance doctrine table (issue-link, diff-size, local-checks, memory-gate, decision-gate, phase-order, actor-check, brain-writes-reviewed) — this repo is rung 2 (detected, not yet substrate-enforced for most checks).
- `npm run brain:change:verify` — Tier 1 autonomous verb per `AGENTS.md` Authority Tiers.
- `npm run brain:audit` (`brain-audit.mjs`) — the 4 generic checks: diffSize, issueLink, adrPresence, memoryPresence, tier-resolved budget (issue #358 Q5, REQ-TIER-9): the diff-size budget comes from ONE tiered source, not a second hardcoded 400-line default inside `diffSize()`.
- `npm run brain:check` (`brain-check.mjs`) — same 4 checks, runnable pre-push.

**Repo doctrine (read directly, not inferred)**:
- `AGENTS.md` (root, **691 lines measured**) is COMPILED by `brain/scripts/harness/backends/antigravity.mjs` from 5 canonical `SOURCE_DOCS`, drift-guarded by `antigravity.drift.test.mjs`. Hand-editing `AGENTS.md` fails CI (drift test). Sections confirmed at these exact lines: `### Tier 1 — Autonomous` (122), `### Tier 2 — Confirm before executing` (136), `### Tier 3 — Prohibited` (151), `# SDD Harness Contract` (193), `# SDD Canonical Layout` (326), `# Workflow Governance — L3 Reference` (403).
  - Tier 1 (autonomous): read any file; create/modify `openspec/changes/**` and `.engram/**`; write `scratch/{agent-id}.md`; run `brain:repo:check`/`backend:build`/`brain:change:verify`; create GitLab issues; propose commits (not push/merge); `mem_save`/`mem_session_summary`; refresh skill registry.
  - Tier 2 (confirm each time): push to any branch; create/merge an MR/PR; modify files in `brain/`; modify `.gitlab-ci.yml`/`settings.xml`/CODEOWNERS; delete branches or committed files; resolve `architecture`/`decision`-type Engram semantic conflicts; publish to the package registry.
  - Tier 3 (prohibited, even if asked): commit directly to `brain/core/**` or `brain/project/**`; approve/merge own MR; rewrite published history (`--force`, `--amend` of pushed commits, rebase of shared branches); **add AI attribution to commits** (Co-Authored-By, session URL, "generated with" footer) — enforced by `commit-msg` + `pre-receive` parity, override key `git config brain.aiAgents`; publish release artefacts without explicit human instruction; escalate decisions to other agents without the human's knowledge.
- **Worktree per issue is the default since #782/#784** (confirmed in code, not just doctrine): `brain/scripts/lib/ticket-args.mjs` defines `WORKTREE_FLAG = '--worktree'` (still accepted, means what it always did) and `IN_PLACE_FLAG = '--in-place'` as **the named opt-out** — a code comment states "THE DEFAULT IS THE FIX." **Gotcha**: `ticket-start.mjs`'s own top-of-file usage docstring (lines 7-10) is STALE — it still reads as if `--worktree` were opt-in ("in-place checkout from main" as the bare default) and does not mention `--in-place`. Trust `ticket-args.mjs`, not the docstring, for current behavior. A stale main-checkout run can also create an in-place branch hours after the default flip (#787 freshness warning; #782 slice 2 makes `hooks/pre-commit` refuse a commit on an in-place branch in the main checkout as the actual backstop).
- `brain/core/methodology/reviewer-protocol.md` (**528 lines measured**) is NOT part of `AGENTS.md` and is easy to miss. **§13 "Subagent Executor Doctrine — invocation via canonical entrypoints"** (line 498) requires a subagent in the reviewer role to be a command executor of `npm run brain:review -- --pr <id>`, never an ad-hoc prompt.
- Diff budget is tier-resolved, not doctrine-table-assumed: measured via `brain.config.json` (`governance.tier: "lite"`) + `workflow-governance.md:22` → **1000 lines for this repo** (tier lite), not the standard/regulated defaults.
- Memory: `npm run memory:share && git add .memory/` before pushing (not run in this init pass — no commit/push performed).

**Known harness gap (measured 2026-08-29, still current)**:
`brain/scripts/harness/backends/claude.mjs` emits ONLY `.claude/settings.json` hooks (confirmed: no `AGENTS.md`/instructions-file write in that module). Only `brain/scripts/harness/backends/antigravity.mjs` compiles + writes an instructions file (`AGENTS_EMIT_PATH = 'AGENTS.md'`, compiled from the 5 canonical `SOURCE_DOCS`). **`AGENTS.md` is NOT auto-loaded into Claude Code sessions in this repo** — confirmed both `.claude/settings.json` and `.gemini/settings.json` exist alongside `AGENTS.md` at repo root, i.e. both backends have been run, but Claude Code only consumes the hooks file. Any phase/agent running under Claude Code must read `AGENTS.md` explicitly. Full detail tracked in Engram topic `harness/claude-code-instructions-gap`.

**Artifact store**: hybrid (engram primary + openspec file artifacts). `openspec/` exists with `changes/` (100+ archived issue-based changes), `specs/`, `config.yaml`. This pass corrected `openspec/config.yaml`'s stale `strict_tdd: false` → `true` and added a measured `testing.baseline` block (see Testing section above) — no other openspec files modified, no commit/push.

**Memory backend**: engram (`.memory/` durable layer per ADR-0002/ADR-0004, symlinked via `.engram`).

**Skill registry**: `.atl/skill-registry.md` rebuilt in this worktree 2026-08-29 (`.atl/` is gitignored/reconstructible and was absent from the worktree — only user-level skill dirs found; no project-level `skills/` dir in this repo). 15 skills indexed from `~/.claude/skills`, `~/.codex/skills`, `~/.agents/skills` (sources: `.pi/agent/skills`, `.agents/skills`, `.claude/skills`, `.gemini/antigravity/skills`, `.codex/skills`). Also cached under Engram topic `skill-registry`.

**Where**: `/home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-456` (worktree, this pass), `/home/gandalf/IA/brain` (canonical checkout), `package.json`, `brain.config.json`, `openspec/config.yaml` (edited this pass), `.atl/skill-registry.md` (created this pass), `AGENTS.md`, `brain/core/methodology/reviewer-protocol.md`, `brain/scripts/hooks/commit-msg`, `brain/scripts/lib/ticket-args.mjs`, `brain/scripts/harness/backends/{claude,antigravity}.mjs`.

**Learned**: Detection this pass was NOT detection-only for `openspec/config.yaml` — the stale `strict_tdd: false` had already been flagged as a risk across 3+ prior observations without being fixed; this pass corrects it since the task explicitly required recording `strict_tdd: true` and hybrid mode writes files. No commit/push was made — the edit sits uncommitted in the worktree, same as any other init-time artifact (`.atl/skill-registry.md`).
